annotations.title: Color palette generator: harmonies and shades from one color

description: Build a colour palette from one hex colour: complementary, analogous, triadic, split-complementary and tetradic harmonies (hue rotations at the same saturation and lightness), plus six shades from light to dark, all as hex codes, with the base colour's HSL. Use for UI themes, charts, brand kits or slide decks; to check text readability on a colour use color_contrast. Example: color=#3366ff. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
